name: Newsletter Writer
tagline: A monthly newsletter drafted in your voice from launches, wins and calendar
description: Puts together each month's newsletter out of the launches, wins and calendar highlights worth sharing, written the way you write, then leaves it parked as a draft so the final edit and the send remain yours. The recurring excuse that there was nothing to say stops working, because the material is already gathered.
author: SpaceX
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
